entities.name: Who are the top 5 players who perform better in crossing actions? Indicate their player id.

entities.name: Which home team had lost the fewest matches in the 2016 season?

entities.name: At present, calculate for the player's age who have a sprint speed of no less than 97 between 2013 to 2015.

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT DISTINCT CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS player_age
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id

entities.name: Which country's players have the heaviest average weights?

properties.sql:
-- The country's players (identified via matches played, using Match.country_id as the player's country) with the heaviest average weight
SELECT c.name
FROM Player AS p
INNER JOIN Match AS m
    ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_1 OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_1
INNER JOIN Country AS c
    ON m.country_id = c.id

ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
